To all the backers of the Kickstarter, MUITO OBRIGADO!
To the friends who helped with handling the rewards, also MUITO OBRIGADO!
And for the last, but just as important, MUITO OBRIGADO to you for giving the series a chance!
To the special girl who was a catalyst for change in my life as I was writing this book, MUITO OBRIGADO! 💜
Sorry it took so long for Vol 3 to come out; it is what it is! I’m not beholden to driving stock value each quarter in this project! Besides, I need to avoid burning out, as this project may seem easy from the outside, but it demands a lot since I’m self-publishing.
Since I’m here anyway, if a big company wants to slap my face with a couple of millions to take over the copyright and trademarks, I’d take it and disappear into the woods and become a shaman at the next Wardruna concert near me— will still go to Magical Mirai and Miku Expo to get my Miku fix, of course! As much as I love this project, it does seem to be growing bigger than myself, and as a simple mortal in the earthly plane, I’d love to spend more time with family and friends, touch grass, and watch/play stuff.
I will be dead in 50 years or so anyway, so I want to make the best out of it and live with no regrets! 🙂
Onward to Vol 4!

Kepada semua penyokong Kickstarter, MUITO OBRIGADO!
Kepada kawan-kawan yang tolong uruskan ganjaran, juga MUITO OBRIGADO!
Dan yang terakhir, tapi sama penting, MUITO OBRIGADO kepada kau sebab beri siri ni peluang!
Kepada gadis istimewa yang menjadi pemangkin perubahan dalam hidup aku semasa aku menulis buku ni, MUITO OBRIGADO! 💜
Maaf sebab Jilid 3 ambil masa lama sangat untuk keluar; nak buat macam mana! Aku tak terikat untuk menaikkan nilai saham setiap suku tahun dalam projek ni! Lagipun, aku perlu elak burnout, sebab projek ni mungkin nampak senang dari luar, tapi ia menuntut banyak sebab aku terbitkan sendiri.
Memandangkan aku dah ada kat sini pun, kalau ada syarikat besar nak tampar muka aku dengan beberapa juta untuk ambil alih hak cipta dan tanda dagangan, aku akan ambil dan hilang ke dalam hutan dan jadi bomoh kat konsert Wardruna yang seterusnya berhampiran aku— tetap akan pergi Magical Mirai dan Miku Expo untuk dapat dos Miku aku, tentulah! Walaupun aku sayang projek ni, ia memang nampak makin besar daripada diri aku sendiri, dan sebagai insan biasa di alam fana, aku nak luangkan lebih banyak masa dengan keluarga dan kawan-kawan, sentuh rumput, dan tonton/main benda-benda.
Aku akan mati dalam 50 tahun lebih kurang pun, jadi aku nak manfaatkan sebaiknya dan hidup tanpa penyesalan! 🙂
Teruskan ke Jilid 4!
